```{r}


plot_shift_with_hist_qty <- function(coef_data, variables, type, matched){
  

  plot_data <- coef_data %>% 
    filter(variable %in% variables) %>% 
    mutate(#estimate = ifelse(variable == "global_tilted_irradiance", estimate*10, estimate)
           pretty_variable = case_when(
      variable == "renewable_day_ahead_forecast" ~ "Renewable Day-ahead Forecast (MWh)",
      variable == "global_tilted_irradiance" ~ "Irradiance (W/m2)",
      variable == "wind_speed_100m" ~ "Wind Speed (m/s)",
      variable == "unpredicted_renewables" ~ "Unpredicted Renewables (MWh)",
      variable == "intraday_update_renewables" ~ "Intraday Update Renewables (MWh)",
      variable == "cbf_es" ~ "CBF (MWh)",
      variable == "cold_excess_supply" ~ "Excess Cold (°C)",
      variable == "heat_excess_supply" ~ "Excess Heat (°C)",
      variable == "cold_excess_demand" ~ "Excess Cold (°C)",
      variable == "heat_excess_demand" ~ "Excess Heat (°C)",
       variable == "Published.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ~ "Nuclear Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Predicted Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Placebo Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ~ "Placebo Nuclear Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      variable == "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" ~ "Placebo Predicted Plant Unavailability (MWh)",
      TRUE ~ variable  # fallback
    ),
    )
  # %>% 
  #   filter(price_test >= -100)
  
  # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
  scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge$gen_tot_da, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
  # Définir les couleurs pour chaque pretty_variable
  custom_colors <- c(
    "Plant Unavailability (MWh)" = "deeppink"	, # Blue
    "Placebo Plant Unavailability (MWh)" = "pink",           # Transparent Blue (unpublished)
    "Nuclear Plant Unavailability (MWh)" = "darkgrey",       # Orange	
    "Placebo Nuclear Plant Unavailability (MWh)" = "lightgrey",   # Transparent Orange
    "Predicted Plant Unavailability (MWh)" = "darkgoldenrod",  
    "Placebo Predicted Plant Unavailability (MWh)" = "lightgoldenrod", # Transparent Green
    "CBF (MWh)" = "purple",                                # Red
        # Purple
    "Irradiance (W/m2)" = "gold",                     # Brown
    "Wind Speed (m/s)" = "#e377c2",                         # Pink
    "Unpredicted Renewables (MWh)" = "lightgreen",
    "Renewable Day-ahead Forecast (MWh)" = "green",   # Gray
    "Intraday Update Renewables (MWh)" = "darkgreen",         # Olive
    "Excess Cold (°C)" = "#17becf",                         # Cyan
    "Excess Heat (°C)" = "red"                          # Light Red
  )
  
  #si on prend simplement le std
  #il y a une variabilité factice de la part des renouvelables
  #parce que varie significativement durant la journéé
  
  # sd_price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  # group_by(creneau) %>% 
  # dplyr::select(all_of(variables)) %>%
  # summarise(across(everything(), ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  # dplyr::select(-creneau) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  # summarise(across(everything(), ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  sd_price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(variables)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)))

  
  
  sd_price_indispo_merge <- data.frame(
  variable = names(sd_price_indispo_merge),
  sd_value = as.numeric(sd_price_indispo_merge))
  
  plot_data <- merge(plot_data, 
                   sd_price_indispo_merge, 
                   by = "variable")
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
    mutate(estimate_shock = estimate * sd_value,
           std_error_shock = std_error * sd_value)
  

  my_plot <- ggplot(data = plot_data) +
    geom_line(aes(x = price_test, y = estimate_shock, color = pretty_variable)) +
    geom_point(aes(x = price_test, y = estimate_shock, color = pretty_variable)) +
    geom_line(aes(x = price_test, y = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        x = price_test, 
        ymin = estimate_shock - 1.96 * std_error_shock, 
        ymax = estimate_shock + 1.96 * std_error_shock,
        fill = pretty_variable
      ), 
      alpha = 0.2
    ) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
    labs(
      #title = paste0("Shift of the ", type, " Curve"),
      x = "Price (€)",
      y = "Quantity (MWh)",
      color = "Variable",
      fill = "Variable"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()


  if (matched == "matched"){
    # Définir un facteur de mise à l'échelle pour que l'histogramme rentre dans l'échelle principale
    scale_factor <- max(plot_data$estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / max(hist(price_indispo_merge$price, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  
    my_plot <- my_plot + 
    # Histogramme mis à l'échelle
    geom_histogram(
      data = price_indispo_merge,
      mapping = aes( x = price,  y = ..count.. * scale_factor),
      bins = 60,
      color = "black",
      fill = NA
    )
    
    # Axe secondaire
    # scale_y_continuous(
    #   name = "Price (€/GWh)",
    #   sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Fréquence de gen_tot")
    # )
  }
  my_plot <- my_plot +
  coord_flip(xlim = c(-20, 165))

  return(my_plot)
}

```
